exposure: Management of PAS: placenta left in situ with uterine artery embolization (UAE)
Management of PAS: partial placenta removal followed by UAE
Management of PAS: obstetric hysterectomy with arterial embolization
cohort: The study included 43 women diagnosed with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders who delivered at a tertiary care center between 2010 and 2020.
finding: Conservative management by leaving the placenta in situ with arterial embolization resulted in less blood loss and fewer postoperative complications, aiding in uterine retention and reduced maternal morbidity, compared to obstetric hysterectomy with arterial embolization.
